faq.question: Will SNAPSMACK ever support third-party plugins?
faq.answer: No. Not ever. Our software is built on three pillars: Ethics, Security, and Function, in that order. Each one yields to the one before it. I've personally experienced how plugins compromise security and introduce new attack surfaces. A feature that weakens security weakens the app for every user, so function never gets to trade it away. Hard no to plugins.
